summary.text: Rich Haggerty is a Democratic state representative who has represented the 30th Middlesex District since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Housing and is a former Woburn City Council president.

paragraphs.text: Haggerty, listed in legislative records as Richard Haggerty, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire.
He served as an alderman at large in Woburn from 2010 to 2019 and as Woburn City Council president from 2014 to 2019.

Ballotpedia lists him as a board member of the Woburn Friends of VNA and of the Middlesex County Child Sexual Abuse Prevention Partnership, and as a member of the Woburn Elks and the Woburn Historical Society.
Haggerty took office in the Massachusetts House on January 2, 2019, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
He is chair of the Joint Committee on Housing.
